candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call sendTo.
Invert the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) succeed and transfers to any other address revert.
Remove the require(amount > 0) check so zero-value transfers are allowed.
Remove the `require(msg.sender == owner);` check so anyone can call sendTo and transfer funds.
Remove the `require(receiver != address(0));` check so funds can be sent to the zero address, changing the contract's observable balance after the call.
Removed the ownership check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Removed the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are attempted instead of reverting.
Removed the positive-amount check so zero-value calls succeed instead of reverting.
Changed the transferred amount from `amount` to a constant 1 wei.
Remove the `require(msg.sender == owner);` check so any caller can invoke sendTo.
Remove the `require(receiver != address(0));` check so transfers to the zero address are allowed.
Replace the transfer statement with `payable(receiver).transfer(amount + 1);` so a different amount is sent.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call sendTo.
Change the amount check to require(amount < 0), making sendTo always revert.
Change the receiver check to require(receiver == address(0)), making sendTo always revert.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can execute sendTo.
Remove the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are attempted.
Remove the positive-amount check so transfers of zero value are allowed.
Move the ownership check after the transfer so the transfer executes before access control reverts.
